newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Bank Negara 91-day bill average yield at 6.755 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank Negara 91-day bill average yield at 6.755 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's central bank said it accepted bids at an average yield of 6.755 percent at its auction of 91-day Bank Negara bills for 500 million ringgit.
At its previous auction on November 5 for a similar amount, bids were accepted at an average yield of 6.767 percent.
The accepted bids were in the high/low range of 6.77/72 percent against 6.775/75 previously.

The central bank also auctioned 30-day Bank Negara bills to raise 500 million ringgit. The bids accepted were at an average yield of 6.836 percent against 6.798 accepted at an auction for a similar amount last week.
The bids accepted for the 30-day bills were in the high/low range of 6.860/795 percent against 6.840/749 last week.
Payment for both issues is on Wednesday. The issues will roll over one billion ringgit maturing from two Bank Negara bill issues on Wednesday.
